title: ledgerwash Baseline Format v1
description: Normative JSON Schema (baseline-format v1, spec-5 extension) for finding and coverage suppression baselines consumed by ledgerwash scan --baseline.

ledgerwash_version.description: Engine version that generated the baseline.

spec_version.description: Engine spec version at baseline creation (must be integer 6).

repo.description: Canonical repository identity at which the baseline was pinned.

epoch.description: 40-hex Git commit SHA at which the baseline was pinned.

ref.description: Git ref as given when generating the baseline.

findings.description: Baselined rule findings bound to instance identity (rule, path, locator, before, after, message) and count.

coverage.description: Baselined incomplete mechanical verification coverage checks bound to (rule, check, path, locator, status, count).

fingerprint.description: Stable finding fingerprint over canonical declared fields (rule, path, locator, before, after, message, count).

rule.description: Rule ID of the baselined finding.

path.description: Repo-relative POSIX path of the record or artifact.

locator.description: Logical record/field location identifier (never line numbers or run timestamps).

before.description: Expected/prior value recorded on the finding instance (or null).

after.description: Observed/current value recorded on the finding instance (or null).

message.description: Canonical finding instance message binding specific violation details.

count.description: Exact multiplicity of this finding instance at the baselined epoch (integer >= 1).

reason.description: Required human-readable justification for suppressing this finding (defaults to 'accepted-legacy').

severity.description: Optional rule severity recorded for human review.

fingerprint.description: Stable coverage check fingerprint over canonical declared fields (rule, check, path, locator, status, count).

path.description: Repo-relative POSIX path of the checked record or directory.

locator.description: Logical locator combining record locator and check name.

status.description: Coverage check status at baseline time ('unverified' never covers a worsened 'mismatch' state).

count.description: Exact multiplicity of this coverage check state at the baselined epoch (integer >= 1).

reason.description: Required human-readable justification for baselining this coverage gap (defaults to 'accepted-legacy').
